game.dany.name: DANY
game.dany.desc: A bluffing card game of bold claims: lay one to three cards face down and swear they add up to your number — then watch the table decide whether to doubt you. Caught lies cost reputation, needless doubts cost it too.
game.dany.rule.1: Each turn, play one to three cards face down and claim a total. The next player may doubt the claim or raise it.
game.dany.rule.2: A caught bluff or a wrong doubt costs reputation. Lose all reputation and you are out; the last player wins.
game.dany.oracle_line: Round {round}: claims must name at least {oracle}.
game.dany.claim_banner: {player} laid {cards} card(s) and claims they add up to {value}.
game.dany.status_select: {player} must lay one to three cards and claim at least {oracle} (round {round}).
game.dany.status_inspect: {player} claims {value} with {cards} card(s) laid — {responder} may inspect or let it stand.
game.dany.claim_prompt: Claim the sum of your laid cards
game.dany.claim_hint: One to three cards must be laid first. Bluffing is allowed — a caught lie costs a reputation, a needless doubt costs one too.
game.dany.select_first: Lay at least one card to make a claim.
game.dany.inspect_prompt: Inspect the claim — or let it stand?
game.dany.fold_prompt: Your hand is empty — fold and wait for the table.
game.dany.log_start: DANY opens with {count} players: {per_player} cards each, {sealed} sealed away.
game.dany.log_claim: {player} claims the {cards} card(s) laid are worth {value}.
game.dany.log_inspected_true: {inspector} inspects {player}: the cards ({cards}) truly add up to {value}. The doubt costs a reputation.
game.dany.log_unchallenged: Nobody doubts {player}; the {cards} card(s) are taken off the table unseen.
game.dany.log_fold: {player} has no cards left and folds.
game.dany.log_eliminated: {player} runs out of reputation and leaves the table.
game.dany.log_new_round: The oracle outgrows three cards — round {round} begins with a fresh count.
game.dany.reason_hands_empty: The hands are empty; insight decides the table.
game.dany.reason_turn_limit: The table reached its turn cap; insight decides the table.
game.dany.error.illegal_action: That is not a legal DANY action right now.
